phase_note: Generated 2026-10-11 by the Phase 11 spec batch (wave 1) in auto-approve mode. 18 requirements / 105 acceptance criteria; 16 design components (the fitdocs.units leaf plus 15 kit components, the eight kinds counted as one); 7 major / 29 leaf tasks: 28 executable plus 7.2*, an optional maintainer-only visual check that does not gate feature GO (analytics-index 8.5 precedent, controller ruling). (P): 2.1-2.4, 3.1-3.4, 5.1-5.8 (16); group 6 is sequential. Research: three read-only Explore subagents surveyed the codebase in parallel (boundary guards and declared registries; chart goldens, palette and theme facts; query result types and unit suffixes), and five scratchpad probes ran (the runtime import closure of render.charts.svg; candidate palettes; a greedy CVD-distance palette search under the 3:1 constraint; ink greys and SVG size estimates; palette verification through palette._oklch_to_hex). Downgrade: no WebSearch/WebFetch, because the controller ruled the run network-free; external standards (WCAG contrast, Machado 2009, OKLab, Heckbert, SVG presentation-attribute precedence) are cited from knowledge and browser behaviour from the Phase 11 discovery probes. Step 3.5 task-graph review ran as an independent reviewer dispatched by the controller, twice. Round 1: NEEDS_FIXES (0 blocking, 10 should-fix, 7 nits), all applied, with design/research edits committed at e29b3bf: prefix pins for the append-only tuples (KINDS, ProblemCode, INK_ROLES, CATEGORICAL_*) and named re-pin points (the kit module tuple and layer-rank matrix in test_boundary.py, the colour whitelist in test_theme_coverage.py); style_element emits CORE_ROLES then extra and never iterates INK_ROLES; marker geometry moved to theme.shape_path so the legend need not import marks; the layer order is guarded by a rank matrix; integer ticks joined the shared layer (linear_ticks/numeric_scale integer=False, controller ruling); the registry reads KINDS at call time; a kind test-module naming convention lets cross-cutting tests cover appended kinds; size budgets are initial, with the test module as source of truth (controller ruling); the determinism run adds an LC_ALL variant; the analytics-index update carried by this spec is named in design and tasks. Round 2: NEEDS_FIXES (0 blocking, 1 should-fix, 3 nits), with all 17 round-1 findings verified resolved. Its four fixes were applied without a third review, because the skill bounds the loop at one re-review: the shared-layer case-class golden mutations moved out of the parallel kind tasks into a new sequential task 6.2 (controller ruling, reviewer option b), with a hard rule that a (P) task never mutates a module outside its own boundary; kind-local at_bound mutations for histogram, stat and table; table/typical carries a DATETIME column so 6.4's timezone mutation is reachable; the rank matrix gives kinds/__init__ the kind rank and resolves from-package-import-submodule, and design's Theme row now lists svg (committed with tasks.md). Accepted trade-off: design.md (1584 lines) exceeds the template's 1000-line advisory, because it settles the seams that two wave-2 specs consume in parallel. Settled seams: fitdocs.units.UNITS is the single unit table (index.schema.UNIT_SUFFIXES projects it, value unchanged); the data contract, ChartRequest, ChartProblem and ChartError, KindSpec, and the declared append-only KINDS with describe_kinds() live in fitdocs.render.charts.kit; the theme uses a #7f7f7f base ink, #707070 light rule and #8e8e8e dark rule (mismatch-safe) and an 8-colour oklch palette. Maintainer-visible: the cadence label stays rpm (the strides/min trap is carried to the dashboards skill); the kit converts no units (pace via 1000.0 / NULLIF(speed_mps, 0) AS pace_s_per_km), which narrows the brief's wording 'pace in min/km from metres per second'; the em dash (U+2014) per the brief, against render/format.py's en dash (U+2013).
